# Ajay Sachdev
> Finance & Operations Manager at a B2B tech scale-up. ACMA CGMA (CIMA), qualified 2026. Builds production AI systems, Power BI dashboards, and financial models. Python, TypeScript, SQL. Based in Cambridge, UK.

## Background
- Sindhi family from Mumbai; grew up in the family textile business (est. 1988)
- Bachelor in Financial Markets, Jai Hind College, Mumbai (2015-18)
- M.Com (Year 1), University of Mumbai
- Diploma in Weaving Technology, Sasmira, Mumbai
- Chartered Wealth Management (AAFM, 2019)
- MSc Finance, Loughborough University (2020-21, 2:1)
- ACMA CGMA (CIMA), qualified 2026
- Joined a B2B tech scale-up in October 2021; now sole finance & ops function across UK, US, Pakistan
- School Governor at a 250-pupil primary school

## Projects
- OpsPilot: AI executive assistant in Microsoft Teams. 95,000+ lines, 43 features live, 6,124+ documents indexed, 100% search accuracy on a 50-query suite. In production 24/7. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/ajay-brain.html
- Trading Bot: FTSE 100 intraday system with four AI agents and an absolute-veto risk auditor. 7,000+ lines. Paper trading: 115+ sessions, zero impulsive trades let through. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/trading-bot.html
- Uni-Nation Digital (uni-nation.in): website, inventory PWA (30,000+ lines) and Hindi voice stock entry for the family fabric business. Roughly $2m of sales data, ~2,000 products, 650+ customers. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/uni-nation.html
- WhatsApp Smart: Chrome extension prototype adding scheduling, AI replies and summaries to WhatsApp Web. 11 features built, privacy-first (messages stay in the browser unless sent to the AI), unreleased. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/whatsapp-smart.html
- SCS Cockpit: zero-dependency study engine he built for his own CIMA Strategic Case Study. 11,584 lines, 166 study items, 23 frameworks. He passed. Retired, job done. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/scs-cockpit.html
